issues.description: The fixed-point width macro FIX_LEN is inconsistent between the template's example program and the template test harness. In template_repository/example_program the code sets FIX_LEN to 8 (64-bit fixed point), while in template_repository/tests the test header defines FIX_LEN as 4 (32-bit). This yields different typedefs for fix_t across compilation units and will cause mismatched data sizes, calling conventions and incorrect expected values when students build/run the tests. The solution repository uses FIX_LEN = 8 consistently, so the template tests appear to be an accidental mismatch that will confuse or block students.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the FIX_LEN macro consistent across the template repository so all compilation units agree on the fixed-point width. Specifically, change template_repository/tests/src/math_fix.h to define FIX_LEN 8 (to match example_program and the solution), or otherwise ensure tests and example_program use the same FIX_LEN. Verify typedefs for fix_t/fixu_t resolve to the same widths across all headers.
